# Image

`c.Image` calls the API's Image group. The Docker images of the host.

| Method                                    | Returns                                  | Permission      | Description                  |

| [`List(ctx, hostname)`](#list)            | `*Response[Collection[ImageEntry]]`      | `image:read`    | List the images of the host. |
| [`Pull(ctx, hostname, input)`](#pull)     | `*Response[Collection[ImagePullResult]]` | `image:execute` | Pull an image.               |

### List

```go
func (s *ImageService) List(
	ctx context.Context,
	hostname string,
) (*Response[Collection[ImageEntry]], error)
```

List the images of the host.

Reads each image through gohai's docker collector, which runs docker images. A
host whose docker does not answer reports skipped.

It sends `GET /api/node/{hostname}/image`, and needs the permission
`image:read`.

The examples of the method's definition:

A host with an image, `go run image.go list`:

```go
resp, err := c.Image.List(ctx, target)
```

### Pull

```go
func (s *ImageService) Pull(
	ctx context.Context,
	hostname string,
	input ImagePullInput,
) (*Response[Collection[ImagePullResult]], error)
```

Pull an image.

Runs docker pull, and answers the ID and the size of the image that the host has
after it. A pull that gets nothing new, because the host had the image of that
reference already, reports changed: false.

It sends `POST /api/node/{hostname}/image/pull`, and needs the permission
`image:execute`.

The examples of the method's definition:

Pull an image, `go run image.go pull`:

```go
resp, err := c.Image.Pull(ctx, target, client.ImagePullInput{Image: "alpine:3.20"})
```

### Delete

```go
func (s *ImageService) Delete(
	ctx context.Context,
	hostname string,
	input ImageDeleteInput,
) (*Response[Collection[ImageResult]], error)
```

Remove an image.

Runs docker rmi, with -f when force is set, which removes an image that a
container uses. An image that the host does not have reports changed: false.

It sends `DELETE /api/node/{hostname}/image/{image}`, and needs the permission
`image:write`.

The examples of the method's definition:

Remove an image, `go run image.go delete`:

```go
resp, err := c.Image.Delete(ctx, target, client.ImageDeleteInput{Image: "alpine:3.20"})
```
